core_business_push_window_check.name: core_business_push_window_check
core_business_push_window_check.value: "core"."business"."push_window_start_hour" between 0 and 23 and "core"."business"."push_window_end_hour" between 1 and 24 and "core"."business"."push_window_start_hour" < "core"."business"."push_window_end_hour"

business_membership_staff_identity_check.name: business_membership_staff_identity_check
business_membership_staff_identity_check.value: "core"."business_membership"."role" <> 'staff' or ("core"."business_membership"."handle" is not null and "core"."business_membership"."pin_hash" is not null)

loyalty_program_closing_window_check.name: loyalty_program_closing_window_check
loyalty_program_closing_window_check.value: ("core"."loyalty_program"."status" <> 'closing') OR ("core"."loyalty_program"."earning_ends_at" IS NOT NULL AND "core"."loyalty_program"."redemption_ends_at" IS NOT NULL AND "core"."loyalty_program"."earning_ends_at" < "core"."loyalty_program"."redemption_ends_at")

loyalty_program_card_gradient_pair_check.name: loyalty_program_card_gradient_pair_check
loyalty_program_card_gradient_pair_check.value: "core"."loyalty_program"."card_background_color_2" IS NULL OR ("core"."loyalty_program"."card_background_color" IS NOT NULL AND "core"."loyalty_program"."card_background_gradient_angle" IS NOT NULL)

loyalty_program_accrual_pair_check.name: loyalty_program_accrual_pair_check
loyalty_program_accrual_pair_check.value: ("core"."loyalty_program"."accrual_mode" = 'per_amount' AND "core"."loyalty_program"."accrual_block_amount" IS NOT NULL) OR ("core"."loyalty_program"."accrual_mode" = 'per_purchase' AND "core"."loyalty_program"."accrual_block_amount" IS NULL) OR "core"."loyalty_program"."accrual_mode" IS NULL

core_campaign_coupon_all_or_nothing_chec.name: core_campaign_coupon_all_or_nothing_check
core_campaign_coupon_all_or_nothing_chec.value: (coalesce("core"."campaign"."template_key", '') in ('welcome', 'cross', 'valley') and "core"."campaign"."coupon_label" is not null and "core"."campaign"."coupon_cost" is not null and "core"."campaign"."coupon_max_redemptions" is null) or (coalesce("core"."campaign"."template_key", '') not in ('welcome', 'cross', 'valley') and ("core"."campaign"."coupon_label" is null) = ("core"."campaign"."coupon_cost" is null) and ("core"."campaign"."coupon_label" is null) = ("core"."campaign"."coupon_max_redemptions" is null))

core_campaign_reward_discount_shape_chec.name: core_campaign_reward_discount_shape_check
core_campaign_reward_discount_shape_chec.value: (coalesce("core"."campaign"."coupon_kind", '') = 'discount') = ("core"."campaign"."coupon_discount_unit" is not null) and ("core"."campaign"."coupon_discount_unit" is null) = ("core"."campaign"."coupon_discount_value" is null)

core_campaign_reward_discount_value_chec.name: core_campaign_reward_discount_value_check
core_campaign_reward_discount_value_chec.value: "core"."campaign"."coupon_discount_value" is null or ("core"."campaign"."coupon_discount_unit" = 'percent' and "core"."campaign"."coupon_discount_value" between 1 and 100 and "core"."campaign"."coupon_discount_value" = trunc("core"."campaign"."coupon_discount_value")) or ("core"."campaign"."coupon_discount_unit" = 'amount' and "core"."campaign"."coupon_discount_value" > 0)

core_campaign_reward_rule_check.name: core_campaign_reward_rule_check
core_campaign_reward_rule_check.value: "core"."campaign"."coupon_rule" is null or ("core"."campaign"."coupon_kind" is not null and char_length("core"."campaign"."coupon_rule") between 1 and 2000)

core_campaign_coupon_needs_end_check.name: core_campaign_coupon_needs_end_check
core_campaign_coupon_needs_end_check.value: coalesce("core"."campaign"."template_key", '') in ('welcome', 'cross', 'valley') or "core"."campaign"."coupon_label" is null or "core"."campaign"."ends_at" is not null

core_campaign_balance_shape_check.name: core_campaign_balance_shape_check
core_campaign_balance_shape_check.value: (coalesce("core"."campaign"."template_key", '') = 'near_reward') = ("core"."campaign"."near_reward_stamps" is not null and "core"."campaign"."near_reward_percent" is not null) and (coalesce("core"."campaign"."template_key", '') = 'unclaimed_reward') = ("core"."campaign"."reward_repeat" is not null) and ("core"."campaign"."near_reward_stamps" is null) = ("core"."campaign"."near_reward_percent" is null)

core_campaign_welcome_reminder_days_chec.name: core_campaign_welcome_reminder_days_check
core_campaign_welcome_reminder_days_chec.value: "core"."campaign"."welcome_reminder_days" is null or ("core"."campaign"."welcome_reminder_days" in (1, 3, 7) and ("core"."campaign"."welcome_valid_days" is null or "core"."campaign"."welcome_reminder_days" < "core"."campaign"."welcome_valid_days"))

core_campaign_welcome_shape_check.name: core_campaign_welcome_shape_check
core_campaign_welcome_shape_check.value: (coalesce("core"."campaign"."template_key", '') = 'welcome') = ("core"."campaign"."welcome_valid_days" is not null and "core"."campaign"."welcome_reminder_days" is not null and "core"."campaign"."welcome_monthly_cap" is not null and "core"."campaign"."welcome_redeem_from" is not null) and (coalesce("core"."campaign"."template_key", '') <> 'welcome' or ("core"."campaign"."coupon_label" is not null and "core"."campaign"."coupon_max_redemptions" is null))

core_campaign_cross_shape_check.name: core_campaign_cross_shape_check
core_campaign_cross_shape_check.value: (coalesce("core"."campaign"."template_key", '') = 'cross') = ("core"."campaign"."cross_audience" is not null) and (coalesce("core"."campaign"."template_key", '') = 'cross') = ("core"."campaign"."cross_valid_days" is not null) and (coalesce("core"."campaign"."template_key", '') = 'cross') = ("core"."campaign"."cross_monthly_cap" is not null)

core_coupon_redemption_units_check.name: core_coupon_redemption_units_check
core_coupon_redemption_units_check.value: ("core"."coupon_redemption"."units_granted" is not null) = ("core"."coupon_redemption"."kind_snapshot" in ('extra_stamps', 'extra_points')) and ("core"."coupon_redemption"."balance_after" is null) = ("core"."coupon_redemption"."units_granted" is null) and ("core"."coupon_redemption"."units_granted" is null or "core"."coupon_redemption"."units_granted" between 1 and 1000) and ("core"."coupon_redemption"."balance_after" is null or "core"."coupon_redemption"."balance_after" >= 0)

core_campaign_coupon_cross_unique.name: core_campaign_coupon_cross_unique
core_campaign_coupon_cross_unique.where: "core"."campaign_coupon"."cross_claimed_at" is not null and "core"."campaign_coupon"."valley_location_id" is null

core_campaign_coupon_reward_discount_sha.name: core_campaign_coupon_reward_discount_shape_check
core_campaign_coupon_reward_discount_sha.value: (coalesce("core"."campaign_coupon"."kind_snapshot", '') = 'discount') = ("core"."campaign_coupon"."discount_unit_snapshot" is not null) and ("core"."campaign_coupon"."discount_unit_snapshot" is null) = ("core"."campaign_coupon"."discount_value_snapshot" is null)

core_campaign_coupon_reward_discount_val.name: core_campaign_coupon_reward_discount_value_check
core_campaign_coupon_reward_discount_val.value: "core"."campaign_coupon"."discount_value_snapshot" is null or ("core"."campaign_coupon"."discount_unit_snapshot" = 'percent' and "core"."campaign_coupon"."discount_value_snapshot" between 1 and 100 and "core"."campaign_coupon"."discount_value_snapshot" = trunc("core"."campaign_coupon"."discount_value_snapshot")) or ("core"."campaign_coupon"."discount_unit_snapshot" = 'amount' and "core"."campaign_coupon"."discount_value_snapshot" > 0)

core_campaign_coupon_reward_rule_check.name: core_campaign_coupon_reward_rule_check
core_campaign_coupon_reward_rule_check.value: "core"."campaign_coupon"."rule_snapshot" is null or ("core"."campaign_coupon"."kind_snapshot" is not null and char_length("core"."campaign_coupon"."rule_snapshot") between 1 and 2000)

core_campaign_coupon_reward_currency_che.name: core_campaign_coupon_reward_currency_check
core_campaign_coupon_reward_currency_che.value: ("core"."campaign_coupon"."currency_code_snapshot" is not null) = (coalesce("core"."campaign_coupon"."discount_unit_snapshot", '') = 'amount') and ("core"."campaign_coupon"."currency_code_snapshot" is null or "core"."campaign_coupon"."currency_code_snapshot" ~ '^[A-Z]{3}$')

core_campaign_coupon_membership_check.name: core_campaign_coupon_membership_check
core_campaign_coupon_membership_check.value: "core"."campaign_coupon"."membership_id" is not null or "core"."campaign_coupon"."cross_claimed_at" is not null

core_campaign_coupon_valley_check.name: core_campaign_coupon_valley_check
core_campaign_coupon_valley_check.value: "core"."campaign_coupon"."valley_location_id" is null or "core"."campaign_coupon"."cross_claimed_at" is not null

core_campaign_coupon_reminder_check.name: core_campaign_coupon_reminder_check
core_campaign_coupon_reminder_check.value: "core"."campaign_coupon"."reminder_queue_id" is null or "core"."campaign_coupon"."welcome_membership_id" is not null

core_campaign_push_holdout_check.name: core_campaign_push_holdout_check
core_campaign_push_holdout_check.value: not "core"."campaign_push"."holdout" or ("core"."campaign_push"."queue_id" is null and "core"."campaign_push"."sent_at" is null)

core_campaign_push_click_check.name: core_campaign_push_click_check
core_campaign_push_click_check.value: "core"."campaign_push"."clicked_at" is null or "core"."campaign_push"."sent_at" is not null

core_location_hours_step_check.name: core_location_hours_step_check
core_location_hours_step_check.value: extract(minute from "core"."location_hours"."opens") in (0, 30) and extract(second from "core"."location_hours"."opens") = 0 and extract(minute from "core"."location_hours"."closes") in (0, 30) and extract(second from "core"."location_hours"."closes") = 0

core_valley_window_hours_check.name: core_valley_window_hours_check
core_valley_window_hours_check.value: "core"."valley_window"."start_hour" between 0 and 23 and "core"."valley_window"."end_hour" between 1 and 24 and "core"."valley_window"."end_hour" > "core"."valley_window"."start_hour"
